title: Unit Event — Friendship Rebuilt — Episode6 Distance

meta.Event Outline: In the wake of iHaz, MORE MORE JUMP! are inundated with work offers. After taking a fresh look at their schedule, Airi and the rest of MMJ consider adopting a work style that makes use of the credit-based course.

rows.Line: One year earlier
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-D

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
I don't have work today. That means I can have lunch at school for a change...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'd be nice to eat with someone...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku...isn't here.
Pretty sure she has that magazine shoot today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Who else is there...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, of course...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... Class A should be...
Huh? Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ayumi, perfect! I was just looking for you! Wanna have lunch together today?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, really. I just happen to not have work today.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Wow, this is great!
We haven't been able to hang out at all since we entered high school and you switched courses...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Oh, is it okay if I invite a few others?
Remember the classmates I introduced you to the other day? We always eat together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
They're welcome to join if they want.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll go ask them now.
Airi, you wait for us down in the courtyard!
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: You and Momoi went to the same junior high, Ayumi? When did you two become friends?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
During our first year.
Our seats were next to each other and we just hit it off.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Yeah, we really did!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Wow. You must've been surprised when you saw a famous idol who's on TV all the time sitting next to you.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Actually, no.
That was before she debuted as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Really? Can you tell us what you were like back then?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Not all that different from now.
I was already in love with idols then...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, but I was pretty rowdy when I was a kid. I preferred to play outside and even got into fights with some boys...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I put all that behind me when I decided to become an idol. Instead, I began learning more about fashion and started working on my singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
And your dream actually came true?
That's so cool, Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I dunno.
It feels more like I've been given a chance to make it happen as opposed to it actually coming true.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, while we're on the subject...
Ayumi helped me out a bunch when I was still trying to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Wait, me? What did I do?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I suppose it didn't seem like much from your perspective...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you never put down my dream of becoming an idol. You always supported me.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ayumi
rows.Line: What? You want to become an idol...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ayumi
rows.Line:
Wow... Th-That's amazing...!
I'm sure you can, Airi! No, I know you can...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What you said that time made me so happy. Most people tended to laugh or snicker when I told them how I wanted to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, it was nice to hear someone giving me their support. You gave me so much encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Wow, that really happened?
Way to go, Ayumi!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I-It meant that much to you...?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But I was just telling you how I felt...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I mean, Airi, you've always had this brilliant aura about you.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: On the day of the entrance ceremony, none of my friends were in my class and I had a lot of trouble talking to anyone else...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Everyone around was chatting and sounded like they were having so much fun... Without me... That made me feel so anxious...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Airi then noticed that I looked really concerned...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: She was actually talking to someone else, but went out of her way to greet me.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: She said, “Hi, I'm Airi Momoi. Nice to meet you.”

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: It was a really simple greeting, but it made me feel so much better for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: After that, we kept talking and eventually became really close...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember that now...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
I won't ever forget.
I mean, when you first spoke to me that day, you were enveloped in this incredible aura...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ayumi...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: It's why I thought it was totally possible when you told me that you wanted to become an idol. If anything, I believed you were really cut out for it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You did...?
It's a little embarrassing to hear that so directly... But thanks. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: The Momoi in that story is exactly what we're used to seeing on TV!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
You really are a friendly and caring person.
I wish I was that close with you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
I'd like that as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know. Why don't you all take this opportunity to start calling me by my first name? That should make things easier, right?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Really?! Then...!
I hope we get to hang out more, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!
A few weeks later
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, I have the meeting for that variety show tomorrow afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm still not sure how I feel about appearing on one of these shows, but I have a duty to fulfill.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I also have that test coming up. I'll need to make some time to study for it. But when...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, a message from Ayumi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Maybe she wants to have lunch.
Come to think of it, I haven't been able to join them lately because work has been so busy...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(And yet, she's still inviting me...
I couldn't be more grateful.)

rows.Speaker: Ayumi's Message
rows.Line: <Airi, have you heard about the field trip already?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Field trip?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi's Message
rows.Line: <Apparently, we're going to PXL and are gonna have some free time to ourselves.>

rows.Speaker: Ayumi's Message
rows.Line: <We can go around the park with people from other classes during that time. Wanna hang out?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right, the field trip... It's really soon, but I'm pretty sure that I...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I have a shoot that day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <As fun as that sounds, I'm really sorry. I have a shoot that day and can't go...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She's taking a while to reply...)

rows.Speaker: Ayumi's Message
rows.Line: <That's okay! I know you're really busy. We can always hang out another time!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Yeah, let's do that one of these days.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One of these days...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Is that day ever going to come...?)
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That shoot went quicker than I expected. If I head home now, I'll have some time to study.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, wait... Wasn't everyone supposed to go on that field trip today?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I hope Ayumi and the others had fun... I'll send her a message later when...)

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Hehe. That was so much fun.
We should go again together sometime.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Huh? That sounded like...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ayumi!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Huh? Airi?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: What are you doing here? I thought you were working...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It ended sooner than expected, so I'm on my way home now. Are you guys just coming back?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Yeah! PXL was really fun!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: It'd been a while since I last went, but it was even more fun than I remembered. I sort of couldn't help but go all out.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Oh, hang on.
We took a bunch of pictures, Airi. Wanna see?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, lemme see!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Where do we start? Oh, how about this one? It's the one of us just after we came out of the haunted house...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... You were totally terrified, Ayumi. Remember when you screamed your lungs out and shoved us forward? You almost made us fall over.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: H-Hey, no one else needs to know about that. Let's look at a different one...

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Hehe. What else was there? Hmm...
Oh, here's when we went to watch that show...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Hey, this is the one we got to take with Phenny! He was so cute!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: He really was! I took a bunch with him too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like you all had a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
We did!
Oh, how amazing was that show?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Yeah, the one at the Phoenix Stage?
They definitely weren't some run-of-the-mill troupe.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
The churros we got after were also really good.
They even had some that were melon soda flavored. I wish I could've given that a try.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Hehe. We can get some the next time we go!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: That includes you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh? R-Right...!
Next time, we...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One of these days...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Is that day ever going to come...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If I raise their hopes again, only to dash them in the end...)

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Um, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, sorry.
I spaced out there for a second.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, PXL...
Yeah, next time... Let's go together.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Airi... I'm sorry.
I was so thoughtless...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I knew you were busy with work and all, but I kept sending you messages and inviting you to hang out...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What...? N-No, don't worry about that.
I really appreciate how you've been inviting me out and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Okay, thanks.
I appreciate you being so polite about this, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, I really do...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot...!
I took some pictures too! Wanna see?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
The view from the Ferris wheel was so pretty.
I hope those turned out okay...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Whoa, hey, this one!
I have such a stupid look on my face...
When did you take this?!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe. I couldn't help it. It was just too funny...

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Really? That's your excuse...
Delete it right now...!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
What?! No, wait! I wanna see!
You're not allowed to delete it until I do!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I was just...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's not a bother... Really...)

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Gimme your phone, Ayumi! I'm getting rid of that pic before anyone else has a chance to see it!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Hey, wait! Gimme back my phone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I guess there's nothing I can do about this...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I placed work before hanging out with my friends. And Ayumi said what she did just now because...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This is the path I chose...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Oh, this is the last one we took together! It turned out a lot better than I realized!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I didn't realize it'd feel this lonely not being included...)
